## Checklist

- [ ] I did not include a phone number or a personal email address, including obfuscated forms.
- [ ] Contact is a LinkedIn URL, GitHub profile, personal site, or a company careers/apply link.
- [ ] Every file this pull request adds, edits, or removes is a post under `jobs/`, `talents/`, or `companies/` (several posts are fine; anything else needs the Softprobe team).
- [ ] The `github` or `posted_by` field is my GitHub login.
- [ ] The path matches the template (`jobs/YYYY/MM/…`, `talents/<letter>/<handle>.md`, or `companies/<letter>/<slug>.md`).
- [ ] The file is Markdown, UTF-8, and under 10 KB.

Changes outside the post folders will not auto-merge. They need approval from `@softprobe/openjob-maintainers`.
